notes.title: Localization Update
notes.content: This patch adds UI language support for 16 different languages. it also adds the ability to invert your Y axis look input.

notes.title: Aura Farming And Story Update Out Now!
notes.content:
This update addresses several review criticisms, adds a new 4-8 hour story mode, and a character redesign for all skins.

Here are the full patch notes:

Content:
[list]
[*] All missions have been reworked into a guided story set across Paradise Mall and the Chrono Station.
[*] Sandbox Mode no longer has missions—only Free Roam. Story Mode contains all missions.
[*] All missions have new music for consistency and to help maintain a cohesive feel. The previous music, from a royalty-free site, was used in other game trailers and didn’t fit the game’s theme, so custom music was created.
[*] Weapon and power unlocks have been integrated into Story Mode to make progression more intuitive and encourage trying different weapons and powers beyond the starter ones.
[*] Wave-fighting missions have been adjusted to be less repetitive.
[*] You now earn 3–4x more money per mission than before.
[/list]

Performance:
[list]
[*] FPS should increase by 30–100% for all users. I went from 55 FPS to 90+ FPS on average.
[*] Steam Deck and similar handhelds should now be able to play the game at higher settings and maintain above 30 FPS consistently. Desktops should easily run above 60 FPS.
[*] Replaced FSR and DLSS with Unreal Engine TSR for better platform compatibility and to keep the engine up to date.
[/list]

Gameplay:
[list]
[*] Flight has been reworked based on feedback, with new heroic animations and improved controls.
[*] Shooting should feel more consistent across all weapons, with better hit detection and more impactful damage.
[*] The menus now have better support for gamepads, specifically the Weapon and Power wheel, which should see significant improvements.
[*] Character controls on gamepad have been tightened and made more fluid, with features like tap-to-sprint (previously required holding), improved aiming, and more responsive button placement.
[*] Camera shakes have been remade across the board and adjusted to reduce nausea while increasing immersion.
[*] The camera now operates on a dolly system, similar to how movies are filmed, for a more realistic and smoother feel.
[*] Cape physics and other cloth physics have been added to the game.
[/list]

Bug Fixes and QOL Changes:
[list]
[*] Slight reverb was added to the world.
[*] Added extra layers to the soundscapes in Paradise Mall.
[*] Reduced loading times by 3–6 seconds.
[*] Fixed an issue with shadows flickering on moving trees caused by overlapping leaves.
[*] Added music to the main menu for a better intro feel.
[*] Fixed an issue where scroll menus did not work with gamepads.
[*] Updated the gun-out animations to look more consistent.
[*] Fixed a bug with delivery missions where the item would clip through the ground or hover above it.
[*] Fixed a bug where quickly switching between weapons would cause the HUD to break.
[/list]

notes.title: June 2025 Community Update
notes.content:
Hey Players, 

I wanted to share what is coming next month(July 2025) with the Story Update and the plans for the update after this one.

Here is what you can expect:

[list]
[*] NPC Optimizations, everyone should get a 20-40% boost in performance, with older or mobile CPUs benefiting the most.
[*] New content with the newly added story mode. The days of trying to find missions and what to do in the game are over. This should increase achievement completion rates as well.
[*] Better gamepad support in the weapon and power wheel. You will be able to move the left thumbstick and pick your weapon or power rather than using the clunky cursor.
[*] Improved environmental sound design with reverb in the cave and jungle biome and new sound effects.
[*] A character redesign for all skins with a cape and cloak matching the colors of the super suit.
[*] Faster loading times.
[*] Finally the flight is being completely reworked based on player feedback. it now has hover, boost, and better animations. It will look much more heroic with sonic booms, better turning animations, and faster movement.
[/list]

Finally I want to share what I am planning for the next update in August or September, it will be bigger than this one and address a large issue with the game which is NPCs.

Here are the plans:

[list]
[*] They will become more intelligent, with the ability to have conversations with them using generative AI tools(it will be good, don't worry), better pathfinding, and smarter behaviors.
[*] I also plan to update the shooting animations and add a weather system in the next update.
[*] Additionally I am going to revamp the technology behind the NPCs to hopefully be vastly more optimized as they are main limiting factor right now in performance.
[/list]


Don't forget to wishlist the game if it interests you and give it a follow.

notes.title: Flight Rework Community Update
notes.content:
Hey players, 

I wanted to give another community update on the new changes coming to the flying in Exo Mayhem.


Based on player feedback, these changes have been made.

1. Flight now starts with slow hover movement with new degrees of freedom, you can use sprint button to fly faster.
2. New animations have been added to make the flight feel more heroic, powerful, and polished.
3. As you fly fast, you will generate sonic booms around paradise mall.
4. Speed has been slightly increased to make it feel faster.
5. All skins now come with cape physics for aura.
6. As part of the story update, flight will be unlocked mid way through the story, you can also jump straight in with sandbox mode at any point.
7. Camera movement has been updated to work on a dolly for more cinematic feel.

I have uploaded a comparison video of the old flight with the new flight coming in the June:
[previewyoutube=crPzWMwNo8s;full][/previewyoutube]


Thank you for the support,
Ryan
Developer

notes.title: April 2025 Bug and Performance Patch
notes.content:
This update fixes several bugs I encountered that were not previously reported while porting to ps5. It also improves the FSR 3 implementation for better performance and smoother frame gen, and reworks how saving is handled to prevent corruption.

Full patch notes below:

Steam Platform:
-Achievements should now unlock for all quests and missions, some had issues with unlocking before.
-Cloud saving should be more reliable now.

Saving:
-Auto save has been removed to prevent issues where the game would close during its process corrupting saves. This may come back in a future update but more testing is needed.
- a new button in the pause menu called "Quick Save" has been added, use this before quitting so your progress is saved.

Combat: 
-Weapons no longer get dequipped when using melee, this also applies to movement speed.
- adjusted look and flight sensitivity.

Rendering:
-DLSS 4 was temporarily removed due to causing issues with multi platform releases, I am looking into how to bring it back, but that will be in a future update. For now FSR 3.1 is being used for all upscaling and frame gen.
- Nvidia reflex removed, though this is planned to return in the future.

Performance:
- Optimized AI a further for more fps; this is an ongoing process, and I expect to get an extra 10-25fps in future updates for low end and mid-range computers.
- Removed asynchronous physics from AI ragdolls as it was in the experimental stage with unreal engine, and some users had issues with ragdolls not working. 
- Fixed an issue that caused AI to move like they are stuttering in far distances.

UI: 
- Pause menu should now close when you press the pause button on your keyboard or gamepad. Previously you needed to click a UI button to close it.


Bug Fixes:
- Zombies should no longer get stuck in a Tpose after dying, this would happen sometimes.
- The police helicopter should now appear faster.
- Fixed an issue in the cave where rocks did not appear in correct spots.
- Fixed an issue that caused the minimap not to render.
- Fixed the delivery mission objects spawning halfway through the ground.

Thank you to the community for your feedback on these updates with reviews, comments, and discussions. Your feedback helps greatly in shaping which features should be added, removed, or changed. Stay tuned for the next update in May!

notes.title: Community Update for April 2025
notes.content:
Sorry about not having new content recently, I have been working hard on a PS5 port for the game, this port is now finishing up so new content and changes can be made again.

In May, I am targeting a release of an update that radically changes how missions are done, instead of them being open world side quests they will instead be done through a story with guided objectives, rewards, and interactions. This means longer playtime, a story to follow on top of the sandbox gameplay reviews recommend, and new experiences for existing players.

Be sure to wishlist and follow the game on steam to know when it drops, alongside when sales happen. 

Thank you for over 200 players so far, hopefully the game can reach 1000 players by end of the year with new content and changes revolving around player feedback. Your reviews help tremendously on what changes need to be made.

notes.title: DLSS 4 and FSR Patch
notes.content:
DLSS 4 and FSR has been added. for GPUs that support it you can use up to 4x Multi-Frame Gen. the game will auto detect which mode is best suited for your PC. This should help giving you extra performance.

Other Quality of life updates have been added as well.

notes.title: QOL Patch
notes.content:
Some users suggested improving these things, so I added them to this patch.

Patch Notes:

1. The gamepad and mouse sensitivity have been increased to give a faster feel. You can still adjust them in the settings to further refine your preferences.
2. Fixed an issue where if you got close to a target with the lock-on system your camera would spin.
3. Added new tips and fixed some typos in the loading screen.
4. Improved the positioning of the aim assist, it should now target the torso and not the waist of enemies.
5. Fixed a bug where the lock-on system would work through store walls.

notes.title: Animation bug fix
notes.content: This patch should resolve an issue where the animations on arsenal would be paused sometimes when you exit the portal.

notes.title: Balance and Gamepad Update
notes.content:
This update focuses on balancing, controller support, and other quality of life improvements, Here are the patch notes:

Gameplay:
[list]
[*] Directional damage indicators now show from where you got hit.
[*] Melee will now lock onto the nearest target.
[*] Ai Enemies can no longer shoot as far giving you time to get away.
[*] Police helicopters should follow you now if you are wanted.
[/list]

Controller:
[list]
[*] A new lock on aim assist feature has been added when you ADS(Left trigger).
[*] Controls have been slightly reworked to feel better. Be sure to check the controls HUD to see what changed.
[*] Using the gamepad in menus and UI should be more stable now.
[*] Look sensitivity has been improved for gamepad users.
[*] Sprinting is now a button hold not a toggle on gamepad.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where returning to the chrono station would not trigger when you walk through the portal.
[*] Fixed an issue where grenades would explode on spawn hitting the player.
[*] Fixed an issue with rocks in specific parts of the level not spawning.
[*] Fixed an issue where medium settings were incorrectly applied as low settings. Be sure to apply your settings again if you were using anything under high settings.
[/list]

UI:
[list]
[*] Made the cursor slightly larger and it should now scale properly with different screen resolutions.
[/list]

Performance:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with stuttering from the level streaming loading in objects on hard drives and lower end devices when flying at top speed.
[/list]

 Thank you to everyone who has left feedback so far, hearing your suggestions and bug reports helps make the game better for everyone. if you left a review regarding controller issues please consider updating your review with this new update.

notes.title: The Apocalypse Update Out Now
notes.content:
This is the first major update of 2025 for Exo Mayhem, featuring new content, improved lighting, improved performance(2x faster), and a lot more. See the full patch notes below:

Patch Notes:

[h2][b]Lighting[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated lighting.
[*] Fog has been improved in Paradise Mall.
[*] New lighting and look for the Chrono Station.
[/list]
[h2][b]Gameplay[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new Zombies mode.
[*] Aim acceleration has been added to improve aiming feel on controllers and mouse.
[*] Completely redesigned main menu with game mode selection and a social/news feed.
[*] New game mode "New Game" renamed to Progression Mode.
[*] You can now shove NPCs and zombies by running into them at full speed.
[/list]

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where moss appeared on characters and was glitchy.
[*] Police no longer attack after you are safe.
[*] Fixed dialogue quips playing even if dialogue volume was set to 0.
[*] HUD position no longer changes unexpectedly.
[/list]

[h2][b]Environment[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added buildings to Paradise Mall to enhance the city atmosphere.
[*] New graphics for Red Death Mall.
[*] Added a downtown background vista to Paradise Mall.
[*] Improved soundscapes in Paradise Mall.
[/list]

[b][h2]General[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Improved NPC performance.
[*] Higher detail LODs on characters.
[*] Added controller vibration support.
[*] Heroic music now plays when flying, ambient music when running with thrusters, and combat music when wanted.
[*] Birds now fly in the sky inside the jungle biome.
[*] NPCs spawn farther from the player.
[*] Updated post-processing for higher visual fidelity.
[*] Damage effect appears on-screen when hit.
[*] Blood effects and heartbeat sounds occur when health drops below 30%.
[*] Waterfall now splashes water on-screen when passing through it.
[*] Speed lines added for flying or thruster running.
[*] Enhanced spatialized audio.
[*] Added slow-motion effect when getting a kill (40% chance with weapons, 100% with laser swords).
[*] All weapons and their tiers have been significantly buffed; early-game enemies are no longer bullet sponges.
[*] Improved police AI; they now shoot during every reposition.
[*] Destroying stores now increases your wanted level.
[*] Police now deploy a helicopter when you are wanted.
[*] Flamethrower now supports fire propagation for extended spread.
[*] Several performance improvements across all levels.
[/list]

notes.title: Quality of Life Update Out Now
notes.content:
This update has the following changes:

[olist]
[*] Azerty Keyboard support.
[*] Improved gamepad support.
[*] Animations related to weapons have been sped up to feel more responsive to controls.
[*] Robbing stores outside of missions now earns you more.
[*] Rampage missions now give you more score per kill, this should make it easier for new players not in sandbox mode.
[*] Bug fix on menus where input would be disabled after closing via a hardware button.
[*] sprinting is now a toggle instead of hold for gamepad users.
[*] Some bug fixes for mission progression.
[*] When trying to open a time portal, if not on level ground UI will appear letting you know.
[*] Main menu now has tooltips for the different modes, just hover over them to know more.
[*] Death menu now has a voice acting line to it.
[*] Holes have been patched in the cave biome.
[/olist]

notes.title: Next Patch Coming Soon
notes.content:
The next patch for Exo-Mayhem will focus on QOL changes such as azerty controls for non-american players, tighter gamepad feeling, faster weapon animations, and some reported bug fixes.

It should be out in mid September, so keep an eye out for that download notification.

notes.title: Sandbox Mode Added
notes.content:
I heard your feedback!

This patch adds a new sandbox mode to the main menu options that allows you to have all powers, weapons, and upgrades unlocked from the get go if you just want to be OP and not worry about character progression. This should alleviate the possible "clunky" low stats feel you would have before upgrading your character to become more powerful. The standard game mode with progression is still an option, you will need to choose which mode you want in the main menu.

This patch also adds a DRM screen to help prevent piracy, it uses steam to handle the DRM so it is lightweight and only checks once when starting the game. You will not see any other differences with this DRM other than a 3-5 second loading screen before getting to the main menu that checks for ownership.

There also have been some bug fixes with new game mode that should be resolved and auto save has been decreased in duration to be every 90 seconds instead of previous 180 seconds. The chrono station also has a objective marker on the door to leave for improved clarity of where to go in that area.
